items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: Yes, often. Used to come around and play on our job like that.

ctx.x: He was the, you mean the old man. No, I mean the one that's living now. The one that used to play drums. Did you ever know him?
Yes, I did know him. Did he ever play with you? Yes, often. Used to come around and play on our job like that. He was a very nice style band.
Harry Sushant told me he took lessons from Chinese, I didn't know that. What did he tell me?
